 【BEST TO SHARE，KAOHSIUNG with LOVE！】Event
 Updated : 2026-11-20 Popularity 64 Back to BEST TO SHARE，KAOHSIUNG with LOVE! 
From the Kaohsiung Coffee Festival and Gangshan Sweet Festival to K-POP random play dance, the Kaohsiung Fashion Awards, and a range of photo check-in missions, exciting events await ARMY! 
 Event 
 ✧ 2026 Kaohsiung Coffee Festival × Shennong Market Purple Food Week 
 Dates | Nov. 21 (Sat.) – Nov. 22 (Sun.), 15:00–21:00 
 Location | Aozihdi Forest Park 
 Highlights | 66 local specialty coffee, bakery and dessert, and indigenous brands join the Agriculture Bureau's Shennong Market, bringing together over 150 coffee, farm produce, and curated lifestyle brands, plus coffee talks and live music 
 ✸ Collect Points: Earn 1 point for every NT$50 spent. Collect 10 points to enter a lucky draw, or redeem a purple dragon fruit & banana ice cream (limited to 200 per day) 
 ✸ Purple Cooking Demos: National Kaohsiung University of Hospitality and Tourism and Shu-Te University team up to demonstrate creative purple dishes on site 
 More Info | 2026 Kaohsiung Coffee Festival Info 
 ✧ 2026 Gangshan Sweet Festival 
 Date | Nov. 21 (Sat.), 14:00–20:30 
 Location | Dianbao River Detention Pond, Zone A (Guoxuan Rd.) 
 Highlights | Local Gangshan shops and dessert brands gather to offer not only Gangshan's Three Treasures but also a creative sweet "Fourth Treasure," along with local creative goods, a curated lifestyle market, and live music 
 Lineup | Shallow Levée, Tsai Chung-Ying, ALI, Shuiguan A-Min, YUMMY MAN (performance times subject to on-site announcements) 
 More Info | Gangshan Sweet Festival on IG 
 ✧ Central Park K-POP Random Dance 
 Dates | Nov. 20 (Fri.), Nov. 21 (Sat.) 
 Location | Central Park Shopping District (next to OFFLINE) 
 Bonus | A limited-edition photo booth truck on site 
 ✧ Fan-Support Floor Decals at Landmarks｜Let's Dance Together 
 Dates | Nov. 17 (Tue.) – Nov. 22 (Sun.) 
 Decal Locations | 
 ✸ Xingaocheng Plaza, Kaohsiung Main Station 
 ✸ Kaohsiung Main Public Library 
 ✸ In front of the Great Harbor Bridge (Pier-2 side) 
 ✸ National Kaohsiung Center for the Arts (Weiwuying) 
 ✸ Starlight Waterfront Park 
 ✧ Youth Riverside Stroll｜KPOP Random Play Dance 
Date | Nov. 21 (Sat.), 10:00–20:30 
Location | Love River Riverside Park, Sanmin Dist. 
Highlights | KPOP random play dance with extra BTS songs, plus a youth market decorated in purple 
✸ Sign up for the KPOP random play dance and check in at the service desk to receive an NT$50 market voucher (limited quantity) 
✸ Creative and food market 14:00–20:30: Visitors dressed in purple can redeem an NT$50 market voucher at the service desk at 14:30 and 16:30 (limited quantity) 
 ✧ BTS Dance Link-Up｜Student Fan Dance Videos 
27 students from Chung Cheng Industrial High School, Chunghwa School of Arts, Fooyin University, Cheng Shiu University, and Shu-Te University filmed fan dance videos at the Great Harbor Bridge, Weiwuying, and Kaohsiung Music Center. 
Dance Video | Released Nov. 13 (Fri.) on the Youth Bureau's social media 
Behind-the-Scenes Video | Released Nov. 17 (Tue.) on the Youth Bureau's social media 
 ✧ Pop-Up Mirror 
 On Display | Now through Nov. 23 (Mon.), 17:00 
 Locations | 
 ✸ Nov. 14 – Nov. 17｜Sunken Plaza, Kaohsiung Main Station 
 ✸ Nov. 18 – Nov. 23｜PINWAY Warehouse No. 8 and Kaohsiung Main Station 
 Bonus | Check in and share at PINWAY from Nov. 18 – Nov. 22 to receive a limited-edition sticker (while supplies last) 
 More Info | Learn More 
 ✧ ARKKO Street Interviews 
 Time | Nov. 20 (Fri.), 14:00–16:00 
 Location | The Pier-2 Art Center 
 Highlights | ARKKO visits Pier-2 to capture Kaohsiung's everyday style. Join a street interview and share your outfit inspiration to receive a limited-edition sticker and a mini round mirror 
 ✧ Purple Photo Mission｜Facebook Event 
 Dates | Nov. 16 (Mon.) – Nov. 22 (Sun.) 
 How to Join | Take a photo with a purple-themed object, post it on Facebook and tag 2 friends. Complete the mission to receive a gift 
 More Info | See the "MeN Go" Facebook fan page 
 ✧ Kaohsiung GO! App Fan Missions 
Dates | During the concert period 
Highlights | Visit the Cultural Affairs Bureau's check-in installations and featured attractions, and complete fan missions all around Kaohsiung 
 ✧ Cijin Ferry Station Exclusive｜Slide Postcard 
 Dates | Nov. 19 (Thu.) – Nov. 22 (Sun.) 
 Redemption Location | Dagang School Shop, Cijin Ferry Station 
 Highlights | Show your BTS WORLD TOUR 'ARIRANG' IN KAOHSIUNG concert ticket to receive one random "Cijin Ferry Station Slide Postcard" in a day or night design (limited to 300, while supplies last) 
 ✧ Fan Event Info on the MeNGo App 
 Dates | Nov. 16 (Mon.) – Nov. 22 (Sun.) 
 Highlights | Check fan event information quickly through banners and QR codes in the MeNGo App 
※ All event details are subject to the latest announcements from each organizer.
